description: This script is a test suite written for shell (bash/sh) that verifies behavior of Perforce (p4) and git p4 clone operations, especially focusing on case sensitivity and path case variations during repository cloning and file handling.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon with case folding enabled.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Configures the client workspace view for Perforce, specifying depot paths and client workspace mappings.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds new files to Perforce version control.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes in Perforce with a description.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a Perforce depot into a git repository, respecting client view and case sensitivity settings.

methods.name: git ls-files
methods.description: Lists files in the git index.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions after test execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output/files for validation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite execution.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up git repositories after tests.
